Subject: Request: CAIQ telemetry provenance for runtime controls

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for taking a look at our CAIQ review. The audit team has a short follow-up focused on runtime telemetry and provenance for the set of controls mapped to the inference runtime (we called this group "edge controls"). They specifically want: 

- A control-to-evidence trace for the runtime telemetry controls (examples: CCM-4.1, CCM-7.2, CCM-11.4) showing where logs are captured and how they map to CAIQ assertions.
- A small, redacted telemetry sample (~2MB) that demonstrates the log schema and retention stamps.
- A short note on collection provenance (who/what emits the telemetry, downstream transforms, and where the canonical copy lives).

We attached a brief ask doc with exact questions (EdgeBank_CAQ_ask.docx). Our deadline for the intake is next Wednesday (2027-08-25) if possible. Priorities: provenance trace + a scrubbed sample.

Can you confirm scope and an ETA? If helpful we can schedule a 30min sync with Sean and Marissa.

Thanks,
Samir

Looping in Sean and Marissa who are owners for runtime telemetry and CAIQ evidence packaging.

—Aditya

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 08:57:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ telemetry provenance for runtime controls

Samir — thanks for the ask. Quick clarifications and notes from the runtime side: 

- Emitters: telemetry emitted from the inference runtime agent (agent-v2) and the routing layer. Canonical collection point is our telemetry ingestion bucket (s3://redwood-telemetry/prod/ingest).
- Transforms: a lightweight enrichment pipeline adds sequence_id and tenant_scope; we keep an immutable gzipped archive and a separate index for fast lookup.
- Retention: raw ingestion archives kept for 90 days, index metadata for 365 days; sampling snapshots are extracted to a separate evidence bucket for audits.

Attached: caiq-provenance-index.csv (small index mapping runtime log paths to control IDs) and a short runbook reference (internal link). We'll produce a scrubbed runtime-telemetry-sample.log with request and response bodies removed — it will include timestamps, event types, sequence_id, and cache/KV references which are relevant for provenance.

On attestations: for CAIQ intake we usually provide owner name + timestamp as evidence; if EdgeBank requires owner signature we can route a brief owner attestation doc (takes 24–48 hours).

Access: I'll pre-sign an S3 link and share it in the final note (we don't put raw samples in email). Expect the preliminary package on 19 Aug by EOD PT.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Platform Security | Redwood Inference

Accepting your proposed ETA. If you can upload the preliminary package to the link in the attached acceptance PDF (EdgeBank_CAQ_Acceptance.pdf) we'll confirm receipt immediately.

If anything changes I'll reach out — otherwise we look forward to the package on 19 Aug.

Best,
Samir
